policy: Original criteria that literally require supplier, fabricated-unit, installed-vehicle, chamber or environmental evidence remain physical acceptance items. Their prehardware engineering status is qualification-only when no further design change is justified.

gates.description: Final KiCad 9.0.9 ERC/DRC/unconnected/parity all zero; 157 exact CAD inputs and 177 fitted models. Independent Gerber/drill/netlist reconstruction passes 145 nets and 571 net-bearing pads. Current native/manufacturing evidence is source-bound to the frozen procurement design.
gates.reopen: Any CAD, BOM, stackup or manufacturing-source mutation.

gates.description: Pinned Arduino/core/NimBLE target build produced verified ELF/BIN outputs. Release behavior remains receive-only on CAN.
gates.reopen: Any firmware, build-profile, dependency or release-feature mutation.

gates.description: Final 0.5/0.25 mm thermal runs retain the 2.940859375 W release budget. The stacked both-80% sensitivity is 3.06708195554 W; at U151 80%, U121 must reach 83.4630636% or an approved measured-loss allocation within the fixed budget. Conditional U152/U153 screens are 105.7765/105.6562 C; L121 winding allocation is 121.6020 C against 125 C including self-rise. Retain I25 workload/environment constraints, the original 112.8829809018675 C physical correlation trigger and explicit lack of mesh convergence. Worst stacked one-step board screen: 113.763359 C.
gates.qualification: Verify the fixed 2.940859375 W release loss budget, <=0.45 A sustained release load, coupled efficiency/loss conditions including U121 >=83.4630636% if U151 is exactly 80% at worst leakage, U201 immediate air <=85 C, 851 local <=60 C, and package/contact temperatures. No threshold is relaxed.
gates.reopen: I25 release-profile/environment violation or failed thermal qualification gate.

gates.description: Fresh frozen-procurement ngspice 42/KLU: 32/32 swap/stress cases, 17/17 normal sequences; main 3.12786634..3.57660977 V, reset margin +11.81634 mV, overshoot margin +23.39023 mV. The 1 us confirmation is 3.5766084 V and 30.08 uH L121 superstress passes. No controller gain, load limit or acceptance threshold was relaxed. Reverse allocation -0.06700731 V; L121 peak 0.942206123 A against 2.5 A. Unchanged input/oil model scopes remain explicitly conditional through the source audit.
gates.qualification: Correlate input/current/rails, startup/reset and oil transfer on the fabricated unit.
gates.reopen: Measured behavior exceeds the controlled model envelope.

gates.description: Complete 14,400-case CAN branch family settles within 1% by 137.600 ns versus representative 1.600 us sampling; sample receiver voltage remains >=1.495510 V for a 1.5 V source and DC ratio >=0.997006499. The 196 repeated 0.9 V crossings are confined to deliberate 2 ns source-edge cases, last <=5.2625 ns below 0.9 V, with zero repeated 0.5 V crossings. R301 remains DNP and firmware TX-disabled.
gates.qualification: Confirm installed fused switched feed/return, controlled harness exit/length allocation, actual vehicle traffic and absence of repeatable branch-attributable CAN errors.
gates.reopen: Installed geometry exceeds allocation, repeatable CAN corruption/error counts correlate with the branch, or CAN transmission is enabled.

gates.description: The exact Adafruit 851/960 product semantics and 28 ohm complete bias-path budget at 25 mA remain. Current 177-part mechanical verification includes 529 mated checks; use mechanics_final for current fit/RF exclusions. The 851 +60 C limit remains an installation-zone requirement. Historical measured-model clearances remain archived and are not promoted as new measurements.
gates.qualification: Keep the 851 local environment <=60 C; inspect supplied SMA center contact and miniature plug/retention; confirm antenna bias >=2.3 V under representative load and module-current limits.
gates.reopen: Supplied interface differs from receiving envelope or installed adapter environment exceeds 60 C without relocation/protection.

gates.description: Retain all 49 filled/capped special vias, stackup, mask and stencil requirements. F101/U401 are the two local installations; L121 is factory supplied with catalogue manual/wave handling. All nine frozen MPN/C-number pairs expose public purchase/preorder paths; 29 unchanged factory references still require source assignment.
gates.qualification: Confirm exact current files/process with JLC and reject or impact-review any deviation in stackup, copper, via fill/cap, mask or assembly process.
gates.reopen: Supplier proposes a design-relevant process deviation.

gates.description: CAD continuity/isolation and population intent are desktop-closed. Physical plating, solder, crimps, contacts and population identity are first-article observations.
gates.qualification: Perform current-netlist continuity/isolation, crimp/pull, population and identity checks.
gates.reopen: A repeatable as-built discrepancy indicates a design/package/process defect rather than workmanship.

gates.description: The PCB RF matching/reference/keepout model is bounded in its stated RF scope. This does not close the wider non-RF return-transfer criterion GND-02. Installed nonlinear clamp/radiated/coexistence behavior remains qualification.
gates.qualification: Correlate installed GPS C/N0, BLE link behavior, ADC/CAN coupling and accessible-port ESD behavior.
gates.reopen: Repeatable installed RF/EMC/ESD failure exceeds the controlled acceptance plan.

gates.description: 177 fitted parts, 175 factory CPL rows and two local installations F101/U401. R156 uses 1206, R160 0805, L121 the manufacturer BPCI land pattern; all frozen tolerances/TCR bounds and exact MPN/C-numbers are checked. Nine new models are documented generic maximum-body envelopes. Full 1.71 mm stack: 1308 populated checks, 529 mated checks, 38 probes, no modeled interference, minimum allocated clearance 0.120 mm. L121 is factory manual/wave handling, not proven automatic SMT. C166 edge tolerance and actual first-article fit remain physical/supplier acceptance. C02 cooling is unadopted.
gates.qualification: Verify received component/cable dimensions, enclosure fit, strain relief/retention and installed clearances against the controlled envelope.
gates.reopen: Actual receiving/install geometry lies outside the controlled envelope.

gates.description: Actual oil response, GPS availability, phone/OS behavior, sustained operation and environmental performance are physical system observations; desktop modeling is exhausted for release design.
gates.qualification: Execute the source-bound acceptance plan on fabricated hardware and vehicle/phone environment.
gates.reopen: A failed physical gate demonstrates a design deficiency outside the bounded prediction.

gates.description: Historical I27 signal-return limits and their source record remain archived. Current I32 native copper, 23 filled-ground connections and power-return allocations pass: 11.282 mOhm against 15 mOhm and 10.919 mOhm against 11 mOhm. Source audit preserves CAN/RF/GPS/oil signal contracts; physical correlation remains required.
gates.qualification: Retain fabricated continuity plus installed CAN/EMC/coexistence correlation; no physical pass is claimed.

gates.description: 7actual paths electrically bounded; optical typical-curve inference retained without guaranteed hot minimum.

All thirteen changed references use the exact frozen nine-MPN set, manufacturer-qualified lands and verified BOM/CPL/native outputs. U101 #W pedigree loss is owner-accepted, with functional H-grade equivalence only.
gates.qualification: JLC process/orientation and incoming-lot handling approval, remaining unchanged sourcing assignments, first-article identity and assembly validation.

prehardware_design_statement: I32 procurement redline is desktop-verified. Supplier process/source assignments and explicit first-article, thermal, bench and vehicle qualification remain open. This record does not authorize an order, merge or hardware operation.
